title: Version 1.40.0
html:
Version 1.40.0 (🎃 Halloween Update  👻)

October 7th, 2023

Added:

  • Added Halloween Balloons
  • Added Cauldron
  • Added Pumpkins
  • Added Green Pumpkins
  • Added 4 new halloween gifts
  • Added 2 new halloween vinyls
  • Added a special Halloween Meteor (Skeletal Meteor)
  • Added 3 new exclusive trees
  • Added Sweetstone and Candy Corn ore
  • Added vehicle color customization (can be accessed via respawn button)
  • Added vinyl machine! Create your own custom vinyls (can be found behind The Oak Depot)
  • Added ? ? ?
  • Added brand new limited time currency (candy)
  • All fireflies collected during October are now ghosts! (Can be sold for candy)

Changed:

  • Empty jars can now be sold for $1800 (10% tax)
  • Filled jars will now sell the content, and leave you with an empty jar
  • Really Black rare car variant has been changed to orange
  • Zinc now spawns in Chalky Slate a lot more
  • Competition trophies no-longer have a useless refresh button
  • Vehicle buttons no-longer display a broken inspect interaction
  • Borderless Conveyor no-longer has collision on the sides
  • Metal Planker behavior now consistent with other machines. (You can run material through again)
  • Revamped Elevators, they now use rods as appose to servos
  • Balloons are now draggable!
  • Removed collision from ropes at the mine entrance
  • Red Maple has been nerfed 30%
  • Petrified Oak has been buffed 20%
  • Blue Pine has been buffed 20%
  • Olive has been buffed 20%
  • Palm has been buffed 15%
  • Cactus has been buffed 10%
  • Lava Slate is now buffed 3x
  • Blackstone is now buffed 2.5x
  • All other stones have been buffed 2x
  • Increased rock spawn rates in the caves

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed issue with electric ore not spawning
  • Fixed issue with Emberbane erroring
  • Gift of Tallness boxed form now unboxes properly.
  • Thunder and lightning has been assigned a sound group.
  • Dragging and rotating speed are now consistent even if FPS is low or high.
  • Fixed Shopping vinyl not playing
